verdict.rationale: Community sources say Ollama now uses a native MLX backend on Mac instead of shelling out to llama.cpp, and a hands-on M4 Pro benchmark shows big throughput gains (30 to 84 tok/s with nvfp4/int4 builds). That points to real Apple Silicon acceleration, but no first-party doc in the pack describes Metal or ARM optimizations, and an older report of very slow MBP inference tempers the picture. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of Metal/MLX/ARM-native acceleration, explicit Metal GPU offload details, and broader independent benchmarks.
